info.title: LLM-MemShare API
info.description: Multi-tenant memory and agent-handoff middleware. A bearer credential establishes the tenant and principal. Responses carry request IDs, and successful protected responses include rate-limit headers.

post.description: MCP Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint for protocol version 2025-06-18. Supports initialize, ping, tools/list, and tools/call.
A2A v0.2.6 JSON-RPC subset supporting message/send and tasks/get with data parts.

IssuedCredential.description: A credential token is returned once
